run.rulesInOwnWords:
State: six tiers (1 nearest the LLM, 6 furthest), each with a chunk count and a HOT/COLD flag. Every tier starts COLD; the starting counts are 3,6,6,2,2,1 (20 in total). Each cycle runs five passes in order, and each pass finishes across all six tiers before the next pass starts.
Step 1, Load: add that cycle's new chunks to each tier. Nothing is trimmed here.
Step 2, Evict: go from tier 1 to tier 6 in order. If a tier holds more than its budget (10,8,12,6,9,7), cut it to the budget and move the excess to the next tier out (i+1) before checking that tier. Excess from tier 6 is dropped.
Step 3, Flag: using the post-evict counts, a COLD tier with count >= its HOT mark (7,6,9,5,7,5) becomes HOT. A HOT tier with count <= its COLD mark (3,2,4,2,3,2) becomes COLD. Otherwise the flag stays the same. Record every change of flag.
Step 4, Rebalance: using the post-flag counts, work out all six amounts first. COLD tiers: floor(count/4), dropped. HOT tiers: floor(count/2), moved to tier i-1; tier 1's promoted amount is dropped. Then apply all six at once. Any overage this creates stays until the next cycle's evict, or stays put after cycle 5.
Step 5, Reset: if the stack total is strictly greater than 38, every tier becomes floor(count/2) and the removed chunks are dropped. A total of exactly 38 does not trigger it.
One drop counter collects tier-6 evictions, compactions, tier-1 promotions and reset removals.

gapsFlagged.rule: Flag step: which count is compared to the marks
gapsFlagged.whatYouAssumed: The post-evict count of the current cycle, since flagging comes right after evict.

gapsFlagged.rule: Rebalance: does a tier receiving a promotion also compute its own amount on the incoming chunks
gapsFlagged.whatYouAssumed: No. All six amounts are worked out from the post-flag counts before anything moves, as the write-up says, and then applied together.

gapsFlagged.rule: Does the flag change after rebalance or reset
gapsFlagged.whatYouAssumed: No. Flags change only in the Flag step. Reset and rebalance change counts only, so the end states are the flags from cycle 5's Flag step.
It is checked once, after rebalance, on the whole stack total. It fires only when the total is above 38.
